<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def orng(fr):
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='O':
            b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
            return (min(rs),min(cs))
    return None
def pegs(fr):
    out=[]
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in 'Ng':
            b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
            out.append((n['color'],min(rs),min(cs)))
    return sorted(out)
print('before O',orng(current_frame),'pegs',pegs(current_frame))
# reduce big box to 1: B2->B4 (over B3), B4->B6 (over B5), B7->B5 (over B6)
for (r,c,tag) in [(15,13,'B2->B4'),(15,25,'B4->B6'),(15,43,'B7->B5')]:
    action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':r,'col':c}])
    print(tag,'O',orng(current_frame),'pegs',pegs(current_frame),{k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ['board_changed','level_completed','done']})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
